opinions.text:
C. A. 7th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 450 U. S. 979.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument denied.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
